hero.titleLine1: Your space. Your taste. Your budget.
hero.subtitle: Upload your space, set your budget and style, and Athathi helps build a design using real furniture you can actually buy.
hero.realCaption: Real catalog pieces · real OMR prices

items.title: Real products
items.desc: Every recommendation is a product that exists in the catalog — never an imaginary render.

items.title: Budget aware
items.desc: Your budget is an input, not an afterthought. Designs are built to fit it.

items.title: Keeps what works
items.desc: Athathi can reuse the furniture you already own instead of replacing everything.

items.title: Designed for your space
items.desc: Recommendations consider your room, its dimensions, and your taste.

how.title: From an empty room to a design you can buy
how.subtitle: A guided journey — not a form to fill in.

steps.title: Upload your room
steps.desc: Add one or more photos of the space you want to furnish.

steps.title: Set budget and style
steps.desc: Tell Athathi your budget in OMR and the look you love.

steps.title: Athathi analyses and matches
steps.desc: It reads the room and matches suitable furniture from the catalog.

steps.title: Review and adjust
steps.desc: See the design, swap pieces, and rebalance the budget.

steps.title: Buy the design
steps.desc: Add the whole design to your cart in one step.

designer.title: Tell Athathi what you have, and what you want
designer.subtitle: A preview of the flagship AI designer. Athathi doesn't replace everything — it works out what the room actually needs.

keep.title: Not everything needs to change
keep.subtitle: Athathi is designed to recognise the pieces worth keeping — so your budget goes where it matters.

budget.title: Your budget is a first-class input
budget.subtitle: Athathi is built to design within a number you set — and to rebalance when you change your mind.

beforeAfter.title: See the same room, transformed
beforeAfter.subtitle: A prototype representation of the intended result — drag to compare.

categories.title: A marketplace built around real rooms
categories.subtitle: Browse the sample catalog by the category that fits your room.

featured.title: Pieces people are designing with
featured.subtitle: Sample catalog data — a taste of the real inventory to come.

styles.title: Find your look, then let Athathi build it
styles.subtitle: Choose visually — no design vocabulary required.

items.name: Warm Modern
items.desc: Soft neutrals, walnut, and natural light.

items.name: Classic Modern
items.desc: Timeless forms with a warm edge.

reference.title: Seen a room you love?
reference.subtitle: Upload a reference you like and Athathi will find similar pieces you can actually buy from the marketplace.
reference.note: Style similarity and product discovery — no copying, no platform affiliation.

custom.title: Can't find the exact piece?
custom.subtitle: Describe what you have in mind and Athathi will turn it into a specification — then connect it with suitable makers.

supplier.title: Athathi isn't only for customers
supplier.subtitle: Stores, manufacturers, and workshops will be able to reach customers at the moment they're designing a room.

finalCta.title: Ready to design your space?
finalCta.subtitle: Start with a room, a budget, and a style. Athathi handles the rest.
finalCta.omanNote: Designed first for the Sultanate of Oman · prices in OMR

hero.title: Furniture chosen for real spaces.
hero.subtitle: Browse a curated sample catalog by category, style, colour and budget — the same structured data the Athathi designer will draw on.

shop.demoNotice: Sample catalog — every product here is honest demo data, not real inventory.

filters.title: Filters
filters.priceRangeHint: Set a minimum and maximum in OMR.

empty.title: No products match your filters
empty.description: Try removing a filter or searching for something else.
empty.customPrompt: Can't find it? Have it made to order.

product.demoNote: Sample product — demo data for this prototype, not real inventory.
product.customizableNote: This piece can be customised — full options arrive in a later phase.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.emptyDescription: Browse the catalog and add the pieces you like.
cart.subtotalNote: Delivery and any taxes are calculated in a later phase.
cart.checkoutNote: Checkout arrives in a later phase — nothing is charged in this prototype.

design.title: Design My Space
design.subtitle: Tell Athathi about your room, budget and taste. It builds a design from real catalog products you can actually buy.

upload.title: Add a photo of your room
upload.subtitle: A visual reference for your design. Your photo stays in your browser.
upload.demoNote: Your photo stays in your browser here. In the next step you can optionally have it analysed — you'll confirm before it's sent anywhere.
upload.formats: JPEG, PNG or WEBP · up to 12 MB
upload.invalid: That file type isn't supported. Use JPEG, PNG or WEBP.
upload.tooLarge: That image is over 12 MB. Please choose a smaller file.
upload.skipNote: A photo is optional — you can continue without one.

vision.title: Analyse my room with AI
vision.intro: Athathi can look at your photo and pre-fill the room type, style, colours, and existing furniture. You review and correct everything.
vision.availableNote: AI analysis is available. Your photo is sent securely for this analysis only.
vision.demoOnlyNote: Live AI analysis isn't configured in this prototype. You can preview the flow with a sample analysis, or simply continue and fill in the details yourself.
vision.privacyBody: Your room image will be securely sent to the selected AI provider for analysis. It is used only to produce this analysis, is not shown publicly, and Athathi does not store it in this prototype.
vision.consentLabel: I understand my image will be sent to the AI provider for analysis.

errors.no-provider: Live AI room analysis isn't set up in this prototype. You can continue by entering the details manually — or see a sample analysis.
errors.invalid-image: That image couldn't be read. Please use a JPEG, PNG or WEBP under 12 MB.
errors.timeout: The analysis took too long. You can try again or continue manually.
errors.provider-error: Room analysis isn't available right now. You can continue by entering the details manually.
errors.invalid-output: We couldn't read a clear result from that photo. Try another image, or continue manually.
errors.rate-limited: Too many analyses right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unknown: Room analysis isn't available right now. You can continue by entering the details manually.

review.title: Here's what we found
review.subtitle: A starting point from your photo — change anything before continuing.
review.sampleNotice: This is a sample analysis to demonstrate the flow — it was not generated from your photo.
review.dimensionsUnknown: Dimensions can't be reliably measured from a single photo. You can add them manually in a later step.
review.applyHint: You can still change everything in the next steps — your choices always win.

suggestionReason.keep: Looks neutral and compatible with your style.
suggestionReason.replace: May clash with the style you want.
suggestionReason.unsure: Worth a closer look — your call.

agent.title: Ask Athathi
agent.subtitle: Adjust this design in your own words — Athathi searches real products, checks your budget, and updates your plan.
agent.inputLabel: Ask Athathi to adjust this design
agent.placeholder: e.g. Make it cheaper and replace the rug
agent.approveTitle: Add {count} pieces to your cart for {total}?

errors.invalid-request: I couldn't read that request. Please try rephrasing.
errors.message-too-long: That message is too long — please shorten it.
errors.state-too-large: Your design is too large to process. Try removing a few items.
errors.provider-error: The Agent isn't available right now. Please try again.
errors.timeout: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

visualization.title: See it in your room
visualization.subtitle: Preview how this design could look in your space.
visualization.sliderLabel: Drag to compare your room with the design preview
visualization.disclaimer: Visual preview — proportions and colours may vary in your actual space.
visualization.demoCompositionNote: A demo composition over your photo — a styling preview, not a real AI-rendered room.
visualization.staleBody: You changed the design after this preview was made, so it no longer matches.
visualization.needPhotoTitle: Add a room photo to preview
visualization.needPhotoBody: Add a photo of your room in the first step to preview this design in your own space.
visualization.sampleRoomNote: Showing a sample room — add your own photo for a preview of your space.
visualization.privacyNote: Your photo stays in your browser for this demo preview — it isn't uploaded.
visualization.consentBody: Your room photo will be sent securely to the AI provider to render this preview only. It isn't stored.
visualization.consentLabel: I agree to send my photo to generate the preview.
visualization.usedSubtitle: Every piece resolves to a real catalog product — no invented names or prices.
visualization.scaleNote: Furniture scale in the preview is illustrative. Check the dimensions above against your space — the preview doesn't prove physical fit.

errors.no-image: Add a room photo to generate a preview.
errors.invalid-image: That image couldn't be used. Try a JPEG, PNG or WEBP under 12 MB.
errors.invalid-request: This design can't be previewed right now. Try adjusting it and updating the preview.
errors.no-consent: Please agree to send your photo to generate the preview.
errors.no-provider: AI preview generation isn't set up in this prototype — showing a demo preview instead.
errors.timeout: The preview took too long. Please try again.
errors.provider-error: Preview generation isn't available right now. Please try again.
errors.invalid-output: We couldn't produce a clear preview. Please try again.
errors.rate-limited: Too many previews right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong generating the preview. Please try again.

room.title: What room are you designing?
room.subtitle: This shapes which pieces Athathi suggests.

budget.title: What's your furnishing budget?
budget.subtitle: In Omani Rial. Athathi designs within it — and won't push you to spend it all.
budget.label: Budget (OMR)
budget.errorInvalid: Budget must be a positive number.
budget.errorTooLow: Budgets under OMR 30 are too low to furnish a room. Try a little more.
budget.errorTooHigh: That budget looks unusually high — please check the amount.
budget.hint: You can change this any time.

style.title: Choose your style
style.subtitle: Pick a main style. Add a second if you like a blend.

existing.title: What do you want to keep?
existing.subtitle: Athathi won't replace what still works — so your budget goes where it matters.
existing.keptNote: Kept pieces are chosen by you in Demo Mode — Athathi doesn't detect them from the photo yet.
existing.none: There's nothing to set aside for this room — continue.

preferences.title: Any preferences?
preferences.subtitle: All optional — these fine-tune your recommendations.
preferences.notePlaceholder: e.g. I'd like the room to feel warmer, and I have young children.
preferences.noteHint: Stored as a note in Demo Mode — not interpreted by AI yet.

review.title: Review your brief
review.subtitle: Check everything, then let Athathi build your design.

analysis.title: Athathi is preparing your design
analysis.subtitle: Building a budget-aware plan from your brief and the Athathi catalog.
analysis.demoMode: Demo Mode — this plan is deterministic, built from your selections and real catalog products. No AI room analysis in this phase.

result.title: Your Athathi design
result.demoNotice: A demo design plan built from real catalog products — not a generated room image.
result.keepingNote: Chosen by you — added at no cost.
result.noCheaper: No cheaper alternative for this piece.
result.noSimilar: No similar alternative for this piece.
result.noUpgrade: No higher-end alternative for this piece.
result.addedNote: All recommended pieces are in your cart. Existing furniture you're keeping isn't added.
result.lowBudgetNote: With this budget, Athathi is focusing on the highest-impact pieces.
result.empty: No products matched this brief. Try a higher budget, a different style, or keeping fewer pieces.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to save designs, favourites and rooms.
auth.signupSubtitle: Save your designs, favourites and rooms across visits.
auth.demoNote: No backend is configured, so this is a local demo account — it lives only in this browser and isn't stored on a server. Connect Supabase to enable real accounts.

errors.invalid-credentials: That email or password wasn't right. Please try again.
errors.email-taken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.invalid-input: Please enter a valid email and your name.
errors.weak-password: Please use a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.backend-error: We couldn't complete that right now. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

account.title: Your account
account.demoTag: Demo account · local to this browser
account.savedDesignsEmpty: No saved designs yet. Build one in Design My Space and save it here.
account.favoritesEmpty: No favourites yet. Tap the heart on any product to save it.
account.ordersComingSoon: Orders arrive with checkout in a later phase.
account.becomeSupplierBody: Run a furniture business? Apply to become a supplier.

suppliers.title: Suppliers on Athathi
suppliers.subtitle: The furniture studios, showrooms and workshops behind the catalog.
suppliers.applySubtitle: Tell us about your business. Applications are reviewed — suppliers are never auto-approved or auto-verified.
suppliers.profileEmpty: This supplier has no public products yet.

apply.submittedBody: Thanks — we've noted your interest. In this prototype, applications aren't reviewed by a real team yet.
apply.demoNote: No backend is configured, so this application is captured locally for the demo and isn't sent anywhere.
apply.signedOutNote: You can apply without an account, but signing in lets us link the application to you.

supplier.title: Supplier dashboard
supplier.demoWorkspace: Demo workspace · changes are saved locally in this browser
supplier.notMemberTitle: You don't have a supplier workspace yet
supplier.notMemberBody: Apply to become a supplier, or open the demo supplier workspace to explore the tools.
supplier.signInFirst: Please sign in to access a supplier workspace.

overview.note: These counts reflect your catalog only. Revenue and orders appear once checkout exists — we don't show numbers we don't have.

products.title: Your products
products.sampleNote: Sample catalog products attributed to this demo supplier. Create your own below.
products.empty: You haven't added any products yet.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.empty: Add products to manage their inventory here.
inventory.note: We never show fake urgency. Inventory reflects only what you set.

requests.title: Requests
requests.empty: No requests yet. Custom requests and quotes arrive in a later phase.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.note: Truthful analytics only. Charts appear once there is real order data — no invented revenue.

settings.title: Settings
settings.demoNote: This is a demo supplier profile. Real profile editing writes to the database when Supabase is configured.

form.name: Name (English)
form.priceHint: In Omani Rial, up to 3 decimals.
form.imagesNote: Image upload uses Supabase Storage when configured. In demo mode, products show the generated catalog artwork.
form.previewNote: This is how your product appears to customers.
form.savedLocally: Saved locally in this browser (demo mode).

custom.title: Custom Furniture
custom.subtitle: Can't find exactly what you want? Describe it, and Athathi turns your idea into a specification suppliers can quote.

start.heading: Tell Athathi what you have in mind
start.fromScratchDesc: Describe a piece from a blank canvas.
start.fromProduct: Base it on a catalog piece
start.fromProductDesc: Start from a product and change what you need.
start.fromImageDesc: Share a photo of something you like.

idea.title: Describe your piece
idea.subtitle: In your own words — Athathi extracts what it can. You confirm everything next.
idea.placeholder: e.g. An L-shaped sofa, dark green velvet, 240 cm wide, 4 seats, budget OMR 120
idea.extracted: Athathi filled in the fields it recognised — review and correct them.
idea.extractNote: Athathi only fills in details you actually stated. It never guesses measurements from a photo.
idea.uploadNote: Your image stays in your browser in this demo — it isn't uploaded.

spec.title: Your specification
spec.subtitle: Add what you know. Leave anything you're unsure about — you can ask the supplier to advise.
spec.budgetHint: Optional, but it helps suppliers quote accurately.

errors.quantity: Enter a quantity of at least 1.
errors.budget: Enter a valid budget, or leave it blank.
errors.needs-detail: Add at least one detail or a reference image so suppliers can quote.

review.title: Your custom specification
review.subtitle: Check everything before Athathi finds suppliers. Nothing is sent yet.

suppliers.title: Suitable suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: Athathi matched these from real supplier data. Choose who receives your request.
suppliers.empty: No suppliers currently make this to order. Try adjusting the category or material.

send.title: Send your request for quotes
send.subtitle: Suppliers will review your specification and reply with a quote. No payment is taken.
send.demoNote: In this demo, suppliers reply instantly with clearly-labelled sample quotes. Real suppliers quote when the backend is connected.

quotes.title: Quotes for your request
quotes.subtitle: Compare the offers and choose the one that suits you. Payment comes later.
quotes.acceptBody: You'll accept {supplier}'s quote of {total}, ready {days}. Payment and the final order follow in a later phase — nothing is charged now.
quotes.acceptedBody: Athathi has recorded your choice. The order and payment step arrives in a later phase.

account.title: Custom furniture requests
account.empty: No custom requests yet. Describe a piece and Athathi will find suppliers to quote it.

supplier.title: Custom requests (RFQs)
supplier.subtitle: Requests addressed to you. Send a quote — the customer compares and decides.

quoteForm.title: Your quote
quoteForm.demoNote: Demo workspace — your quote is saved locally in this browser.

errors.manufacturingDays: Enter a realistic number of days.

custom.promotedNote: Advertising never affects Athathi's recommendation. Suggestions are based only on how well a quote fits your request.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.emptyBody: Your cart is empty. Browse the catalog to add pieces.
checkout.signInBody: Sign in so we can save your order to your account.

summary.title: Order summary
summary.priceChangedBody: A price changed since you added it - your order uses the current catalog price.
summary.droppedTitle: Some items are no longer available
summary.droppedBody: They were removed from your order.

delivery.title: Delivery details
delivery.subtitle: Where should Athathi deliver? We use Oman address fields.

errors.invalid-phone: Enter a valid Omani phone number.

totals.deliveryUnknownNote: Delivery for catalog items is arranged with the supplier - no fee is added here.

review.title: Review & confirm
review.paymentNoteBody: Confirming records your order. Payment and fulfilment arrive in a later phase - nothing is charged now.

confirmed.title: Order confirmed
confirmed.body: Thank you. We've recorded your order.
confirmed.demoBody: This is a demo order saved in your account - no payment was taken and no real supplier was notified.
confirmed.payLaterNote: You can also pay later from your order page.

orders.title: Your orders
orders.empty: No orders yet. When you check out, your orders appear here.

detail.title: Order
detail.notFoundBody: We couldn't find that order for your account.
detail.paymentNote: Payment and fulfilment are not part of this order yet - they arrive in a later phase.

supplier.title: Orders
supplier.subtitle: Orders that include your products. You only see your portion.

footer.tagline: Upload your space, set your budget and style, and let Athathi design and prepare it for you.
footer.madeIn: Designed for the Sultanate of Oman
footer.rights: Prototype · Internal build — sample data throughout

payment.title: Payment
payment.notFoundBody: We couldn't find that order for your account.
payment.liveNote: A live payment gateway isn't configured, so payment runs in demo mode.
payment.demoNoticeBody: No card is collected and no real money moves. This simulates a payment gateway so the whole flow can be reviewed end to end.
payment.noCardNote: We never ask for card, CVV, PIN, or bank details here.
payment.outcomeHint: Choose how the demo gateway responds, then continue.
payment.verifyHint: The demo gateway has your payment. Verify it to confirm — the result is checked server-side, never assumed.

failed.title: Payment didn't go through
failed.body: The demo gateway declined this attempt. No money moved — you can try again.

payment.paidBody: Your demo payment is confirmed. Your receipt is below.

receipt.title: Payment receipt
receipt.note: This is a demo receipt, not a tax invoice.

fulfillment.demoNote: Fulfillment runs in Demo Mode — supplier and customer notifications are recorded, not actually sent.

supplier.title: New paid orders
supplier.subtitle: Paid orders awaiting your action. You only ever see your own products.
supplier.empty: No paid orders yet. Paid orders that include your products appear here.
supplier.acceptConfirmBody: You confirm you can fulfill your part of this order. The customer is notified (Demo Mode).
supplier.declineIntro: Tell us why you can't fulfill this order. The customer sees a short reason, not your internal note.
supplier.declineNoteHint: Only visible to you and Athathi — never shown to the customer.
supplier.readyToast: Marked ready for the next stage
supplier.awaitingHint: Review the order, then accept or decline.
supplier.preparingHint: Pick, prepare and pack your items, then mark ready.
supplier.readyHint: Ready for the next fulfillment stage.
supplier.customReadyHint: Accepted — the manufacturing workflow can begin in a later stage.

timeline.title: Order progress
timeline.declinedBody: This supplier declined your order. No further preparation happens for their items.
timeline.readyCatalogNote: Your items are ready for the delivery handoff (a later stage).
timeline.readyCustomNote: Accepted — the custom manufacturing workflow can begin (a later stage).
timeline.awaitingNote: The supplier has been notified and will review your order.

summary.allReady: All suppliers ready for next stage
summary.label: Fulfillment

manufacturing.demoNote: Manufacturing runs in Demo Mode - supplier and customer notifications are recorded, not actually sent.

card.empty: No manufacturing jobs yet. Custom orders marked ready for the next stage appear here.

milestones.title: Production milestones
milestones.hint: Tick milestones as you complete them. Optional - for your own tracking.

qc.title: Quality check
qc.checklistHint: Confirm every criterion to pass. If anything is wrong, record an issue instead.
qc.allRequired: All criteria must be confirmed to pass.

qc.checklistIncomplete: Confirm every criterion to pass, or record an issue.

detail.title: Manufacturing job
detail.noActions: No actions available in this state.

timeline.title: Manufacturing progress

summary.allReady: All custom pieces ready for delivery

slots.title: Delivery window

detail.title: Delivery
detail.noActions: No actions available in this state.

failure.title: Report a failed delivery

installIssue.title: Record an installation issue

tracking.completedBody: This item has been delivered and handed over. Thank you.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.none: You're all caught up. New updates about your orders and designs appear here.
notifications.demoNote: In-app notifications only. Email, WhatsApp and push are not connected.

memory.title: Design memory & preferences
memory.subtitle: Athathi can remember your design preferences to improve future suggestions. You control what's saved and can delete it anytime.

memory.useInDesign: Use my saved preferences in new designs
memory.useInDesignHint: Let Athathi and the assistant suggest your saved style when you start a room.
